profile_text.body:
Baichuan AI is a Beijing-based company founded in 2023. The company describes its mission as helping the general public easily and equitably access world knowledge and professional services, and states that it is committed to building China's leading large language model foundation through breakthroughs in language AI.

The company's primary product is Baichuan, a Chinese open-source large language model that includes fine-tuned variants for medical and legal applications. Users accessing the model across borders are advised to review applicable data regulations before doing so.
